questions.question: In which district of Karnataka is the Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.questionHtml: In which district of Karnataka is the Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.solution:
Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary, located in Kodagu District covers an area of about 181 sq km. It is surrounded by evergreen and semi-green forests as well as shola grasslands.

The species of animals found in the sanctuary are gaur, elephant, tiger, leopard, jungle cat, leopard cat, wild dog, sloth bear, wild pig, sambar, spotted deer etc.

The sanctuary derives its name from the highest point, the Brahmagiri peak, which is 1607 m in height.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.questionHtml: In which of the following states is the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.solution: Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area and tiger reserve as part of the Project Tiger, situated in Chikkamagaluru district, Karnataka.

questions.question: The Bandipur National Park is located in which of the following states?
questions.questionHtml: The Bandipur National Park is located in which of the following states?

questions.question: In June 2022, the Supreme Court directed that every protected forest, national park and wildlife sanctuary across the country should have a mandatory eco-sensitive zone (ESZ) of a minimum _______ starting from their demarcated boundaries.
questions.questionHtml: In June 2022, the Supreme Court directed that every protected forest, national park and wildlife sanctuary across the country should have a mandatory eco-sensitive zone (ESZ) of a minimum _______ starting from their demarcated boundaries.
questions.solution: The Supreme Court has mandated that all protected forests, national parks, and wildlife sanctuaries in India must establish an eco-sensitive zone (ESZ) of a minimum 1 km distance from their demarcated boundaries.

questions.question: In 2020, which of the following tiger reserves won the 'TX2 Award' for its efforts to increase the tiger population?
questions.questionHtml: In 2020, which of the following tiger reserves won the 'TX2 Award' for its efforts to increase the tiger population?
questions.solution: Uttar Pradesh's Pilibhit Tiger Reserve in 2020 was awarded the first TX2 Award for having doubled its tiger population from 25 tigers to 65 in 2018.

questions.question: Select the natural habitat of the Asiatic Lion from the following.
questions.questionHtml: Select the natural habitat of the Asiatic Lion from the following.
questions.solution:
· The Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica) is exclusively found in the Gir Forest National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary in Gujarat, India.

· It is the only natural habitat of this endangered species, with ~700 lions (2023 census).

Why Not Others?

· Sundarbans: Home to the Bengal Tiger (mangrove forest).

· Kanha NP: Famous for tigers and barasingha (Madhya Pradesh).

· Saranda Forest: Largest sal forest in Jharkhand (no lions).

Key Fact: Asiatic lions were once widespread but now survive only in Gir due to conservation efforts.

· Manas Biosphere Reserve is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Assam, known for its biodiversity and rich wildlife including the tiger and golden langur.

Madhya Pradesh → Pachmarhi

· Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve is located in the Satpura range and includes forest areas rich in flora and fauna.

Odisha → Similipal

· Similipal Biosphere Reserve in Odisha is famous for its tiger population, dense forests, and rich biodiversity.

Meghalaya → Nokrek

· Nokrek Biosphere Reserve, near Tura in Meghalaya, is home to rare species and is an important biodiversity hotspot in the Northeast.

Further Insight:

India has 18 designated biosphere reserves recognized by UNESCO, each playing a crucial role in conserving biodiversity and fostering sustainable development.

questions.question: Which national park in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is home to species like Megapode, Crab-eating Macaque, Nicobar Pigeon, and Giant Robber Crab?
questions.questionHtml: Which national park in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is home to species like Megapode, Crab-eating Macaque, Nicobar Pigeon, and Giant Robber Crab?

questions.question: Which of the following National Parks is located in Madhya Pradesh?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following National Parks is located in Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
· Bandhavgarh National Park: Located in Madhya Pradesh, known for its high tiger density and historical fort.

· Conservation Role: Bandhavgarh is part of Project Tiger, contributing to India's tiger population recovery (3,167 tigers per 2022 census).

· Other Options:

o Nanda Devi: In Uttarakhand, famous for its Himalayan biodiversity.

o Periyar: In Kerala, known for its elephant and tiger reserves.

o Silent Valley: In Kerala, noted for its rainforest and rare species.

questions.question: Laokhowa wildlife sanctuary lies on the outhern bank of which river in the north - eastern states of India?
questions.questionHtml: Laokhowa wildlife sanctuary lies on the outhern bank of which river in the north - eastern states of India?
questions.solution: The Laokhowa wildlife sanctuary lies on the banks of the Brahmaputra River and is a part of the Laokhowa-Burachapori eco-system. The sanctuary is an ideal habitat for Asiatic water buffaloes and the one-horned rhinoceros. This wildlife sanctuary has the Kaziranga National Park about 40 km downstream from the Brahmaputra river basin along-with the Orang National Park located about 30 km northwest on the other side of the Brahmaputra River.

questions.question: Which of the following states has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following states has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary?
questions.solution: The Gahirmatha Marine Wildlife Sanctuary is the only marine sanctuary of Orissa. In 1997 the Government of Orissa declared the area as Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary considering its ecological significance and diverse floral and faunal resources.

questions.question: The first phase of the 'action plan for introduction of the Cheetah in India' witnessed ___ being released in the Kuno National Park of Madhya Pradesh in September 2022.
questions.questionHtml: The first phase of the 'action plan for introduction of the Cheetah in India' witnessed ___ being released in the Kuno National Park of Madhya Pradesh in September 2022.
questions.solution: In September 2022, as part of the initial phase of the 'action plan for the introduction of the Cheetah in India,' a total of 8 cheetahs were released into the Kuno National Park located in Madhya Pradesh. This marked a significant step in the conservation efforts aimed at reintroducing cheetahs into their historical habitat in India.

questions.question: In which state is Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.questionHtml: In which state is Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.solution:
· Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the state of Telangana, specifically in the Mancherial District (formerly part of Adilabad District).

· It was established in 1965 and declared a Tiger Reserve in 2012, known for its rich biodiversity and as a catchment area for the Godavari and Kadam rivers.

Further Insight:

· Gujarat: This state is home to the Gir National Park, famous for Asiatic lions, but Kawal is not located here.

· Odisha: While Odisha has sanctuaries like Simlipal, Kawal is not in this state, though it has ecological linkages with regions like Chhattisgarh, which neighbors Odisha.

· Maharashtra: Kawal borders Maharashtra and connects to its forests like Tadoba-Andhari, but it is situated within Telangana's boundaries.

questions.question: In which state of India is the Chandra Prabha Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.questionHtml: In which state of India is the Chandra Prabha Wildlife Sanctuary located?
questions.solution:
Chandra Prabha Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the Chandauli district of Uttar Pradesh. It is known for its diverse flora and fauna, including leopards, deer, and many bird species.

It was once a home to Asiatic lions, which were introduced here in the 1950s, but the project did not succeed. Today, the sanctuary is a significant eco-tourism destination.

Hence, option (3) is the correct answer.

questions.question: In which state of India is the Tadoba National Park located?
questions.questionHtml: In which state of India is the Tadoba National Park located?
questions.solution: Tadoba National Park, also known as Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, is located in Maharashtra. It is one of the largest and oldest national parks in the state and is famous for its Bengal tiger population.

questions.question: The Wild Life (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022 received the assent of the President on ________.
questions.questionHtml: The Wild Life (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022 received the assent of the President on ________.
questions.solution:
· The Wild Life (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022 received the President's assent on December 19, 2022.

· This act amended the original Wild Life Protection Act, 1972.

· This amendment was a significant update to India's Wildlife Protection Act, bringing it in alignment with international conventions like CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora) and introducing provisions for better protection and management of wildlife.

· The Wild life (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022 has come into force since 1st April 2023.

· Section 49 M of the Act provides for registration of possession, transfer and birth and reporting of death of living scheduled animal species which are listed in the Appendices of CITES and as such listed in the Schedule IV of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.

questions.question: Where is the Sariska Tiger Reserve located?
questions.questionHtml: Where is the Sariska Tiger Reserve located?
questions.solution: Sariska Tiger Reserve is a tiger reserve in Alwar district, Rajasthan, India. It stretches over an area of 881 km² comprising scrub-thorn arid forests, dry deciduous forests, grasslands, and rocky hills. This area was a hunting preserve of the Alwar state and was declared a wildlife sanctuary in 1958.

questions.question: Match the following. Column A Column B 1) Guindy National Park a) Rajasthan 2) Bandipur National Park b) Tamil Nadu 3) Ranthambore National Park c) Karnataka
questions.questionHtml:
Match the following.

Column AColumn B
1) Guindy National Parka) Rajasthan
2) Bandipur National Parkb) Tamil Nadu
3) Ranthambore National Parkc) Karnataka
questions.solution:
Guindy National Park is located in Chennai, which is in Tamil Nadu. This matches with option 1-b.

There are over 14 species of mammals including blackbuck, chital or spotted deer, jackal, small Indian civet, common palm civet, bonnet macaque, hyena, pangolin, hedgehog, common mongoose and three-striped palm squirrel. The park also has black-naped hare and several species of bats and rodents.

Bandipur National Park is located in Karnataka, which matches with option 2-c.

Bandipur National Park, located in Karnataka, India, is a renowned wildlife sanctuary and tiger reserve known for its diverse flora and fauna. It's part of the larger Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and is a significant conservation area for tigers and other endangered species.

Ranthambore National Park is located in Rajasthan, which matches with option 3-a.

Ranthambore National Park is most famous for its tiger population. It's considered one of the best places in India to see wild tigers. While many other animal species inhabit the park, the high density of tigers makes it a popular destination for wildlife enthusiasts.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is/are correct? I - Maximum National Parks in India are located in the state of Madhya Pradesh. II - Mudumalai National Park is located in Kerala. III - The Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History is located in Tamil Nadu.
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I - Maximum National Parks in India are located in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

II - Mudumalai National Park is located in Kerala.

III - The Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History is located in Tamil Nadu.

options.text: Both I and II are correct
options.html: Both I and II are correct

options.text: Both I and III are correct
options.html: Both I and III are correct

questions.solution:
· Madhya Pradesh has the highest number of national parks in India. According to the Madhya Pradesh Forest Department, the state is home to 11 national parks, including Kanha, Bandhavgarh, and Satpura. ​

· Mudumalai National Park is located in the Nilgiri District of Tamil Nadu, not Kerala. It shares borders with Kerala and Karnataka but is situated within Tamil Nadu. ​

· The Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History (SACON) is located in Anaikatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. It serves as a national center for ornithology and natural history research. ​

There are 106 existing national parks in India covering an area of 44,402.95 km2, which is 1.35% of the geographical area of the country (National Wildlife Database Centre, Nov. 2023).

In addition to the above 75 National Parks covering an area of 16,608 km2 are proposed in the Protected Area Network Report (Rodgers & Panwar, 1988).
